cover_headline: Ramayana Opens With Rs 42.96 Crore in Day 1 Advance Sales, Bollywood's Second-Best Ever
facts: Ramayana closed its day 1 advance booking at Rs 42.96 crore gross in India excluding blocked seats, from 12.14 lakh tickets
That makes it Bollywood's second-best opening-day pre-sales ever, behind only Dhurandhar 2 (Rs 53 crore) and ahead of Jawan (Rs 40.75 crore)
The film opened across 26,615 shows, the highest show count ever for a Bollywood film, in Hindi, Kannada, Telugu, Tamil and Malayalam versions

end.headline: Ramayana Opens With Rs 42.96 Crore in Day 1 Advance Sales, Bollywood's Second-Best Ever
end.line: The Ranbir Kapoor-Yash epic is the highest pre-sales ever for a non-sequel, with Koimoi projecting an opening day of Rs 91-101 crore net in India.
